area: internal orders, cost centers, allocations, planning
notes: Business actions for /sc4sap:assist, executed only through ZMCP_BIZ_EXECUTE on the SAP side.
Draft 2026-11-09: interface and source checked on ECC740-DEV only; S4-DEV and ECC731-DEV pending.
testrun CHECK_FM = a separate check FM (check_fm) runs the same checks without posting; CHECK_ONLY = the same FM with a check-only flag; none = preview from facts and biz-rules.
Customer exits for orders and allocations are system specific and live in biz-rules/CO.json of the profile, not in this catalog.

actions.title: Show an internal order (master data, system / user status, allowed business transactions)

en: what can I do with this order

ECC.note: returns SYSTEM_STATUS, USER_STATUS and ALLOWED_BUS_TRACT (business transactions allowed in the current status); the handler reads the order header from AUFK and the active statuses from JEST, no person responsible

S4.note: returns SYSTEM_STATUS, USER_STATUS and ALLOWED_BUS_TRACT (business transactions allowed in the current status); the handler reads the order header from AUFK and the active statuses from JEST, no person responsible

actions.title: List internal orders by company code, type, status or responsible cost center

clarify.ask: Which orders: created, released, technically complete, closed, or all?

ECC.note: internal orders (order category 30) of the controlling area, status taken from the active JEST rows (created, released, teco, closed, locked, all_open); no BAPI needed

S4.note: internal orders (order category 30) of the controlling area, status taken from the active JEST rows (created, released, teco, closed, locked, all_open); no BAPI needed

auth.note: CO_ACTION 0003 = display; orders of an order type the user may not display are left out and counted

actions.title: Release, complete technically (TECO), close, lock or unlock an internal order, or revoke the closing

ambiguity.ask: By closing, do you mean technical completion (TECO) or final closing (CLSD)?

clarify.ask: Which status: release, technically complete (TECO), close, lock, unlock or revoke the closing?

ECC.set: OBJNR = order object number (OR + order), VRGNG = TJ01 business transaction of the target: release FREI, TECO BTAB, close BABS, lock BLOC, unlock BUNL, revoke close BUAB
ECC.preview: static checks of the handler on the active JEST statuses (already released / locked / closed, flagged for deletion) + STATUS_CHANGE_FOR_ACTIVITY with CHECK_ONLY = X + CO.ORD.GET_DETAIL (allowed transactions) + biz-rules/CO.json
ECC.note: CHECK_ONLY is a weak preview: it accepts lock on a locked order, close on a released order and release when the status profile does not allow it; the handler therefore adds its own status checks. Persistence is in the update task: the handler waits for the JEST change and reports an error when nothing changed (a status profile with a user-status precondition can make release and revoke close a no-op). No BAPI_INTERNALORDER_CHANGE on this release.

S4.set: OBJNR = order object number (OR + order), VRGNG = TJ01 business transaction of the target: release FREI, TECO BTAB, close BABS, lock BLOC, unlock BUNL, revoke close BUAB
S4.preview: static checks of the handler on the active JEST statuses (already released / locked / closed, flagged for deletion) + STATUS_CHANGE_FOR_ACTIVITY with CHECK_ONLY = X + CO.ORD.GET_DETAIL (allowed transactions) + biz-rules/CO.json
S4.note: CHECK_ONLY is a weak preview: it accepts lock on a locked order, close on a released order and release when the status profile does not allow it; the handler therefore adds its own status checks. Persistence is in the update task: the handler waits for the JEST change and reports an error when nothing changed (a status profile with a user-status precondition can make release and revoke close a no-op). No BAPI_INTERNALORDER_CHANGE on this release.

fields.CO_ACTION: 0011 release, 0013 TECO, 0014 close / revoke close, 0015 lock, 0016 unlock

auth.note: the handler checks the CO_ACTION of the requested target

en: The SAP status check is weak; the handler adds its own status checks.
Status profiles with user-status steps can accept the request without changing the status; the result then says so.
Authorization and customer checks that run only at save can still refuse the change at execute.
ko: SAP 상태 체크가 약해요. 핸들러가 자체 상태 체크를 더해요.
사용자 상태 단계가 있는 프로파일은 요청을 받고도 상태를 바꾸지 않을 수 있어요. 그때는 결과에서 알려요.
저장할 때만 도는 권한 체크와 고객 체크는 실행할 때 거절할 수 있어요.

actions.title: Show a cost center (validity, responsible area, lock indicators)

ECC.note: validity (key date), hierarchy area, category and lock flags from CSKS, text from CSKT in the logon language; the person responsible is a personal data field and is not returned

S4.note: validity (key date), hierarchy area, category and lock flags from CSKS, text from CSKT in the logon language; the person responsible is a personal data field and is not returned

actions.title: Actual versus plan of a cost center for a period range

clarify.ask: From which period to which period?

ECC.note: actual = value type 04 (version 000), plan = value type 01 of the requested version (default 000), totals per cost element for the period range, summed from COSP and COSS; amounts are returned in the real currency amount (SAP stores two decimals for every currency); no standard BAPI reads cost-center totals

S4.note: ACDOCA on S/4 (CO postings are in the universal journal)

actions.title: Show primary cost plan data of a cost center

ECC.note: primary plan values (value type 01 of the plan version) per cost element and period from COSP; BAPI_COSTACTPLN_READPRIMCOST was tried and returned no values for period plans

S4.note: reads classic plan data (COSP); S/4 plan data in ACDOCP is not read. S4-DEV 2026-11-10: no classic plan values

actions.title: Repost actual costs from one cost object to another (manual cost allocation)

en: move cost to another cost center

params.name: lines
params.note: each line: name=value pairs separated by ; (from_cc or from_order, to_cc or to_order, cost_element, amount, text), values percent-encoded for % ; =

clarify.ask: Which posting date? The CO period of that date must be open.
From which cost object to which, which cost element and how much?
clarify.when: sender, receiver, cost element or amount is missing

ECC.set: DOC_HEADER (CO_AREA, DOCDATE, POSTGDATE, DOC_HDR_TX) + DOC_ITEMS (sender / receiver objects, COST_ELEM, VALUE_TCUR)
ECC.preview: BAPI_ACC_MANUAL_ALLOC_CHECK (K40C_CO_ACTUAL_POSTING_CHECK: authority, header, lines, locks, cost element, period) + biz-rules/CO.json
ECC.note: a receiver order can create an FI document (the FI number range and customer FI validations then run); the CO document type is KAMV (posted to COSS)

S4.set: DOC_HEADER (CO_AREA, DOCDATE, POSTGDATE, DOC_HDR_TX) + DOC_ITEMS (sender / receiver objects, COST_ELEM, VALUE_TCUR)
S4.preview: BAPI_ACC_MANUAL_ALLOC_CHECK (K40C_CO_ACTUAL_POSTING_CHECK: authority, header, lines, locks, cost element, period) + biz-rules/CO.json
S4.note: a receiver order can create an FI document (the FI number range and customer FI validations then run); the CO document type is KAMV (posted to COSS)

en: A receiver order can create an FI document: FI checks (number range, closing date) then apply at execute.
Authorization and customer checks that run only at save can still refuse the change at execute.
ko: 받는 쪽이 오더면 FI 전표가 생길 수 있어요. 그때는 번호범위, 마감일 같은 FI 체크가 실행할 때 적용돼요.
저장할 때만 도는 권한 체크와 고객 체크는 실행할 때 거절할 수 있어요.

actions.title: Reverse a manual cost repost or activity allocation (CO document)

clarify.ask: Which CO document number should be reversed?
Which posting date for the reversal? The CO period of that date must be open.

ECC.set: DOC_HEADER (CO_AREA, RVRS_NO = document to reverse, DOCDATE, POSTGDATE, DOC_HDR_TX); the new document number comes back in the DOC_NO table
ECC.preview: no check mode: preview = static checks of the handler on COBK (document exists, business transaction RKU1 / RKL / KAMV, not already reversed, not itself a reversal)
ECC.note: the reversal itself is not reversible

S4.set: DOC_HEADER (CO_AREA, RVRS_NO = document to reverse, DOCDATE, POSTGDATE, DOC_HDR_TX); the new document number comes back in the DOC_NO table
S4.preview: no check mode: preview = static checks of the handler on COBK (document exists, business transaction RKU1 / RKL / KAMV, not already reversed, not itself a reversal)
S4.note: to be re-verified on the S/4 system

en: No check mode: static checks on the original CO document only.
Authorization and customer checks that run only at save can still refuse the change at execute.
ko: 체크 모드가 없어요. 원래 CO 전표만 보고 판단해요.
저장할 때만 도는 권한 체크와 고객 체크는 실행할 때 거절할 수 있어요.

params.name: lines
params.note: each line: cost_element, amount per period (the amount replaces the existing plan values of that cost element in every period of the range; 0 removes them)
